notes.title: Cradlemoor features in video for new MA, and progress update
notes.notes: [p]We're super-excited that Cradlemoor is featured in the University of Exeter's new promotional video for their MA in Interactive Storytelling Design.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pEHpMZSYTfA"][/dynamiclink]Despite rumours to the contrary, Cradlemoor is still very much alive and work is ongoing. We've filmed 95% of the content and are now in the process of putting together the gameplay and scoring the music. New trailer coming soon![/p]
